items.a: It depends on the product, but the minimum is typically 50–100 units. For smaller orders, please get in touch and we'll help find a suitable option.
Standard orders are delivered within 24–48 hours across Ho Chi Minh City & Binh Duong. Large-volume or custom orders may take 3–5 days.

items.q: What file formats do you accept?
items.a: We accept AI, PDF, and PSD files in CMYK, at a minimum resolution of 300dpi. If you don't have a design file yet, our free design team can help.

items.q: Do you deliver outside Ho Chi Minh City & Binh Duong?
items.a: Yes. We deliver nationwide through shipping partners — cost and delivery time depend on the destination.
We accept bank transfer, cash on delivery, and contract-based billing for corporate clients.
